title: Pilot Study on In-vivo Non-invasive Skin Imaging Using Multiphoton Microscopy
official: Non-invasive Skin Imaging Using Multiphoton Microscopy
summary: The purpose of this pilot study is to employ multiphoton microscopy to non-invasively image in-vivo pigmented and non-pigmented human skin lesions for characterization of their morphologic and functional features.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male or Female all age groups
* Ability to understand and carry out subject instructions

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant women
